hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools (YES/NO) that implements VALS dynamic fees, computing fees as e^[λ·(Δx/L)·σ]−1 using a backend-signed volatility parameter (σ). Fees are routed to a YieldDistributor rather than LPs; swaps require a valid signed sigma payload in hookData and revert if the market is resolved or disputed.
